name: Buahan A Banyan Tree Escape
short_description: An adults-only, 16-bale 'no walls, no doors' jungle escape in northern Ubud, each bale with a private pool and 180-degree mountain views.
ai_summary: Buahan A Banyan Tree Escape is an adults-only property in Buahan village, northern Ubud, built on a 'no walls, no doors' concept that immerses guests directly in the Balinese jungle. Each of the 16 bales (villas) is roughly 180 sqm, features a 180-degree view of jungle and mountain peaks, a private pool, and naturally sourced materials reflecting Balinese architecture. The resort sits above the Ayung River with uninterrupted panoramas of Bali's mountain ranges. As a Banyan Tree-managed property bookable through ALL Accor, standard programme benefits apply.

core_facts.address: Banjar Selat, Desa Buahan Kaja, Payangan, Gianyar, 80572 Bali, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
